title: The Subjunctive
subtitle: Wishes, commands, conditions — still alive in Middle English.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.
Prepare for sustained reading in Stage 3.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: Present subjunctive often identical to infinitive (that he love, that they come). Past subjunctive: were, hadde, mighte. Used in conditions, wishes, commands, subordinate clauses after 'that.' Subjunctive is stronger in Middle English than in modern English but weaker than in Old English.

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you apply this to reading?
items.answer: Work through examples with your notes.
